author: Wiojohan5
quote: A disappointing game, filled with glitches, bugs, and technical issues that negatively affect the overall experience. It also seems to focus excessively on sexual and explicit content, while heavily incorporating controversial themes such as racism and homosexuality. Instead of focusing on gameplay quality and delivering an enjoyable experience, the game seems more interested in pushing controversial content.Overall, a huge disappointment. Not what I expected.
